Agigongnyong Dooly.name: The Dinosaur Dooley
Agigongnyong Dooly.summary: The Dinosaur Dooley is a Shoot-'Em-Up game, developed by Daou and published by Innovation Tech, which was released in Korea in 1991.

Dynamite Headdy.name: Dynamite Headdy
Dynamite Headdy.summary: The Game Gear port of Dynamite Headdy. It was later ported for the Master System by Tec Toy, released only in Brazil.
